# PM031: good-first-incomplete

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | PM |
| product | frob |
| severity (default) | error |
| tier | universal |
| scope | repo |
| fix | manual |
| polarity | P+ |
| must_measure | false |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

A ticket labelled `good-first` is missing something a newcomer needs.

Names each missing part: points above the maximum or unset, no scope, a
criterion that is not Given/When/Then, or no `## Start here` section.

## Remedy

Fill in the named parts, split the ticket to fit the point limit, or remove the
`good-first` label.

## Examples

### PM031 good-first ticket incomplete / A complete good-first ticket is silent #1 (line 10) (clean)

```text
task a labels=good-first points=2 scope=src/a.rs criteria=1
```

### PM031 good-first ticket incomplete / Five points fires naming the points #2 (line 16) (fire)

```text
task a labels=good-first points=5 scope=src/a.rs criteria=1
```

### PM031 good-first ticket incomplete / A missing Start here section fires #3 (line 22) (fire)

```text
task a labels=good-first points=2 scope=src/a.rs criteria=1 start_here=none
```

### PM031 good-first ticket incomplete / A missing scope fires #4 (line 28) (fire)

```text

```

